text: dsh-retention-settlement-proof 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 的离线删除结算证明插件。它向 DSH 注册清单检查和结算验证两个工具：检查工具概览证明清单，验证工具读取工作区内的请求、墓碑与缺席观察票据，核对哈希、必需存储面和重启后的观察周期，并生成内容寻址的 JSON 报告。它只核验已记录的证据，适合需要确认留存或删除请求是否在多个存储投影中持续生效的场景。运行需要显式工作区中的证明文件和报告目录；实现不调用外部服务，也不需要 API 密钥。

dsh-retention-settlement-proof verifies retention evidence offline. Its DSH tools inspect a manifest or check request, tombstone, and absence receipts across required storage surfaces and restarts. It writes a JSON report from workspace files and needs no external service or API key.
想离线确认一条删除请求在重启后仍然没有对应数据。
如何核对墓碑和删除请求是否匹配，并验证多个存储面都记录了缺席？
I need to verify recorded absence evidence across storage surfaces after a restart.
dsh-retention-settlement-proof 的功能「结算证据核验」：通过 DSH 工具读取工作区清单及其引用的请求、墓碑和观察票据，核对身份、摘要、时效、必需存储面与重启周期，输出核验结论及内容寻址报告。
dsh-retention-settlement-proof 的功能「证明清单检查」：调用 inspect 工具解析版本化清单并返回证明 ID、主体哈希、观察数量、必需存储面和重启周期要求，不读取文件系统中的票据正文。

dsh-retention-settlement-proof README · dsh-retention-settlement-proof：**Maintainer / Author：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen) · [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)**

Offline, body-free evidence that a recorded DeepSeek Harness retention/deletion request settled across required storage projections and stayed absent after restart.

dsh-retention-settlement-proof README · dsh-retention-settlement-proof：This plugin **does not delete anything**. DSH session persistence currently has no general delete/retention API, while community archive/delete plugins implement different mutation strategies. This proof layer consumes explicit, pre-recorded receipts from those implementations or test harnesses. It is complementary to `dsh-recovery-proof` (restore drills), `dsh-decision-effect-proof` (authorization/effect reconciliation), and deletion UIs: it answers only whether one opaque subject remained absent across declared surfaces and restart epochs.

dsh-retention-settlement-proof README · Evidence contract：Any later `present: true`, stale receipt, missing surface, pre-restart-only evidence, identity mismatch, digest mismatch, unsafe path, or incomplete threshold fails closed. The report contains hashes and verdicts only—not session text, receipt bodies, filesystem paths, credentials, or secrets.

dsh-retention-settlement-proof README · CLI：```bash
dsh-retention-settlement-proof inspect --workspace . --manifest proof.json
dsh-retention-settlement-proof verify --workspace . --manifest proof.json --artifactDir artifacts
```

dsh-retention-settlement-proof README · CLI：Verification reads only workspace-relative regular files, rejects symlinks and traversal, performs no network requests or subprocesses, and writes only one content-addressed JSON report beneath the explicit artifact directory with exclusive creation and read-back verification. Exit code 0 means `verified-absent`, 2 means a policy rejection, and 1 means invalid/unsafe input.

dsh-retention-settlement-proof README · DSH and MCP：The DSH bundle exposes `dsh_retention_settlement_inspect` and `dsh_retention_settlement_verify`. The independent stdio MCP server exposes proof-only inline equivalents and never accesses the filesystem. Both call the same interface-free core.

dsh-retention-settlement-proof README · dsh-retention-settlement-proof：作者 / 维护者：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen)· [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)

面向 DeepSeek Harness 的离线、无正文“删除结算证明”：验证一条已录制的删除/保留请求是否在必需存储投影中完成，并在重启后持续缺席。

本插件**绝不执行删除**。它只读取显式、带哈希的请求、墓碑和缺席观察票据；任何复活、陈旧、缺面、仅重启前观察、身份或摘要不一致都会失败闭合。报告不含会话 ID、会话正文、原票据、路径或秘密。

```bash
dsh-retention-settlement-proof verify --workspace . --manifest proof.json --artifactDir artifacts
```

所有输入和输出都限制在显式 workspace，拒绝符号链接与路径逃逸；无网络、无子进程、无真实会话修改。
